clips.title: The story
paras: This quest represents Motley Garmason's bitter quest for vengeance against the Dark Iron dwarf Kam Deepfury. Deepfury masterminded the assault on the Thandol Span, which claimed the lives of Bronzebeard defenders, including the brother of Longbraid the Grim. Dissatisfied with Stormwind's political detention of the culprit, Motley enlists an adventurer to enact dwarven justice inside the Stockade.

The northern reaches of the Wetlands bleed from perpetual clashes between the Bronzebeard defenders at Dun Modr and the insurgent Dark Iron dwarves. When the Thandol Span came under attack, the sabotage cost vital dwarven lives, including the brother of Longbraid the Grim. Intelligence gathered by Roggo revealed that Kam Deepfury planned the deceitful strike. Instead of facing execution on the front lines, however, Deepfury ended up secured inside the Stormwind Stockade—held as a political prisoner rather than executed for murder.

Stationed at Dun Modr, Motley Garmason refuses to allow Stormwind's political calculations to shield a war criminal. To Motley, human bureaucracy has placed decorum above blood debts. Bound by duty to remain at Longbraid's side in the Wetlands, Motley tasks trusted champions to march deep beneath the human capital, brave the rioting Stockade, and claim Deepfury's severed head to settle the clan's score once and for all.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have proven your loyalty to King Magni, adventurer. And your hatred for the Dark Iron scum is as great as my own.

There is a task I wish to complete myself but I am bound by honor to stay with Longbraid. But Roggo has gathered intelligence that proves Kam Deepfury was a conspirator in the attack on the Thandol Span. It was by Deepfury's planning that Longbraid lost his kin.
Deepfury is being held for political reasons in the Stormwind Stockade. I want him dead, friend. For Longbraid! Bring me his head!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I won't let foolish Human bureaucracy interfere with Dwarven matters, friend Kam Deepfury is a proven conspirator in the Thandol Span attack. King Magni's good people lost their lives because of Deepfury's deceit. The Humans might be content to let Deepfury rot in The Stockade but I will not sleep soundly at night until Deepfury is slain.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So Kam Deepfury finally got to feel what it is like to be on the receiving end of Death? Good. Serves the cowardly Dark Iron scum right. You have done well, adventurer. The victims of the Thandol Span attack were but mere victims in a world torn with war and unrest. Their families will have the peace of knowing Deepfury got the punishment he deserved. Longbraid's brother's death has been avenged.
